panel.title: ⚡ Kisk — quick actions
panel.body:
No commands to remember — click a button, pick from the menus, fill in the blanks:

📅 **Create an event** — dungeon, raid, battleground, PvP...
🏖️ **Report an absence** — let the legion know when you're away

Joining an event stays one click on its {tank} Tank / {heal} Heal / {dps} DPS buttons.{where}
panel.pin_tip: 💡 Pin this message, then use `/channels events: #… absences: #…` so the results are posted in their own channels instead of pushing the panel out of sight.
